title: Editor becomes partially unresponsive. Still can open the main menu options (File, Edit, etc) but can't interact with the editor
body:
### Tested versions

Godot version: v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]

### System information

Windows 11, Forward+ Renderer, Laptop with dual GPUs (nVidia GeForce GTX 1650 driver ver. 572.70; Intel UHD driver ver. 27.20.100.9664)

### Issue description

Could not find reproduction steps. I tried creating a new project and the bug happened so it doesn't appear to be something in my project.

The editor will sometimes not update its main area. I can still use the main menu and they will open, but the main area will not reflect any changes. If I have multiple tabs open, I can click on them and see the title change, but the corresponding window will keep showing the content of the old tab.

Tried opening Godot with console and the following error appears in a loop when this happens.

`ERROR: QueuePresentKHR failed with error: VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST`

Below is a video after the bug happened. Notice I'm clicking on tab names and the current scene changes, but the actual content doesn't reflect that. I also grab in the video the console outputting the error above.

https://streamable.com/bqo5uy


### Steps to reproduce

Can't reproduce issue consistently. It happens seemingly at random while using the editor (opening windows, changing tabs, selection options in combo boxes, etc). It happened in both a brand new project and on an already ongoing project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
